units.source_text: 我等倘无同群伴侣，亦将不堪孤寂了。”

en.t: If we had no companions of our own kind, we too could not bear the loneliness."

units.source_text: 他的父亲伊豫介已迁任常陆守。

en.t: His father, the Iyo Assistant Governor, had already been transferred to the post of Governor of Hitachi.

units.source_text: 他不随父亲赴新任地常陆，而随源氏公子来此流放地。

en.t: He did not accompany his father to his new post in Hitachi, but instead came with Prince Genji to this place of exile.

units.source_text: 其心中虽有牵虑，但外表装作若无其事，

en.t: Although he had worries in his heart, outwardly he pretended that nothing was the matter,

units.source_text: 精神抖擞地殷勤侍候公子。

en.t: and served the prince attentively with lively spirits.
